label: Campaign link
purpose: Which campaign link the visit carried, by its UTM source, medium, and campaign. Tells automated flows from campaign sends, and Meta links that carried a campaign from those that did not.
data: The bundle's link channel rules, first match wins: automated_email_flow, affiliate, google_ads (a cpc medium), campaign_email_sms, meta (a Meta source or paid medium with a medium or campaign set), meta_no_link (the same without either), no_campaign_link (no medium and no campaign); anything else is other_tagged.
